environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAF WebACL (waf-acl-prod-docs) is associated with the ALB ARN. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'prod-query-sanitization' with a single RegexPatternSet rule matching field QUERY_STRING with patterns including the set arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:regional/regexpatternset/sql-fragments/uuid containing patterns: (?i)(union\s+select|union\s+all\s+select), (?i)(\b(select|insert|update|delete|drop|alter|create)\b.*\b(from|into|table|database)\b), ('\s*(or|and)\s*'?\d), (--\s*$|/\*|\*/), (?i)(\bwaitfor\b|\bbenchmark\b|\bsleep\b) — action BLOCK with custom response code 403, and (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action. Rate-based rule at 2000 requests per 5 minutes per IP. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with an Athena table partitioned by date, and a scheduled Lambda runs hourly checking for 403 response spikes. The ECS task role has no permissions beyond ECR pull, CloudWatch Logs, and S3 read for config. Container runs as non-root with read-only root filesystem except /data mount.
